esp32.detail: 4 pins wired; U2.GATE → D25 (GPIO25). U2.ENVELOPE → D32 (GPIO32) — an analog-capable pin. Added a 10 kΩ / 15 kΩ divider on GATE: it swings to 5 V, and the D25 pin takes 3.3 V at most. Added a 10 kΩ / 15 kΩ divider on ENVELOPE: it swings to 5 V, and the D32 pin takes 3.3 V at most. Added the sound_detector.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the envelope level and gate state set on the controls: passes

Added a 10 kΩ / 15 kΩ divider on ENVELOPE: it swings to 5 V, and the GP28 pin takes 3.3 V at most. Added the sound_detector.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the envelope level and gate state set on the controls: passes
